meaning.en: Year after year, again and again as the years go by.

examples.zh: 年年岁岁，这棵老树都开满了花。
examples.en: Year after year this old tree is covered in blossom.

examples.zh: 年年岁岁花相似，岁岁年年人不同。
examples.en: The flowers are alike year after year, but the people change as the years go by.

examples.zh: 他年年岁岁都回老家过年。
examples.en: Every single year he goes home for the New Year.

story.en: Liu Xiyi's poem on an old man's white hair has the lines 'Flowers look the same year after year; people are never the same year after year' (年年岁岁花相似，岁岁年年人不同).
story.zh: 刘希夷《代悲白头翁》：“年年岁岁花相似，岁岁年年人不同。”

usage.en: Adverbial, with a literary and slightly wistful flavour. Mostly seen in the famous couplet by Liu Xiyi, where the second half is the reversed form 岁岁年年. Plain 年复一年 is more common in speech.
usage.zh: 多作状语，书面、略带感慨。多见于刘希夷名句，后半句为倒装的“岁岁年年”。口语里更常说“年复一年”。

meaning.en: Deserted and lonely, with hardly anyone around.
meaning.zh: 场面冷落，人很少，不热闹。

examples.zh: 放假后，校园里冷冷清清。
examples.en: After the holiday began the campus was deserted.

examples.zh: 这家商店生意不好，每天冷冷清清。
examples.en: The shop is not doing well and is empty every day.

examples.zh: 过年时一个人在外，感觉冷冷清清的。
examples.en: Spending the New Year alone away from home feels lonely.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial, from the AABB pattern. Used of places, shops and moods. A common colloquial word, in the same family as 冷清. Opposite of 热热闹闹.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，AABB式叠词，用于场所、店铺、心情。反义词是“热热闹闹”。

meaning.en: Looking so strange, filthy or thin that one hardly seems human.
meaning.zh: 样子古怪难看，不像个正常人。

examples.zh: 他熬夜打游戏，把自己弄得不人不鬼的。
examples.en: He stayed up gaming and made himself look a wreck.

examples.zh: 流浪了几个月，他变得不人不鬼。
examples.en: After months of wandering, he looked like a ghost.

examples.zh: 别把自己搞得不人不鬼的，注意形象。
examples.en: Don't let yourself look such a wreck; pay attention to your appearance.

usage.en: Predicate or complement. Colloquial and rude when said to someone's face; usually humorous about oneself or critical of others. It is not a fixed classical idiom, so it is rarely found in formal writing.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语，口语，当面说较不礼貌。不属于典雅成语，正式文章中少用。

natural: speak and act on one's own

meaning.en: To do things one's own way without consulting anyone; also, to talk to oneself.
meaning.zh: 不听别人意见，自己做主；也指自己跟自己说话。

examples.zh: 他做事总是自说自话，从不和大家商量。
examples.en: He always does things his own way and never discusses them with anyone.

examples.zh: 你不要自说自话，先问问爸爸妈妈的意见。
examples.en: Don't just decide for yourself; ask Mum and Dad first.

examples.zh: 会上他自说自话，没人理他。
examples.en: In the meeting he just spoke to himself and nobody paid attention.

usage.en: Predicate. Mainly used of someone high-handed or self-willed; the second sense (talking to oneself) is close to 自言自语. Mild criticism, colloquial.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，主要指自作主张，含批评；也可指自言自语。口语。

meaning.en: Tasty or enjoyable, said of food or of someone who is enjoying doing something.
meaning.zh: 味道很好，或兴致很高，过得很有趣。

examples.zh: 孩子们吃得有滋有味。
examples.en: The children ate with great relish.

examples.zh: 爷爷听戏听得有滋有味。
examples.en: Grandpa listened to the opera with great enjoyment.

examples.zh: 退休后，他把日子过得有滋有味。
examples.en: After retirement he made his days full of interest and savour.

usage.en: Usually an adverbial or complement after 吃得, 看得, 过得. Warm and colloquial. Compare 津津有味, which is about interest and enjoyment.
usage.zh: 多作状语、补语，常见“吃得”“看得”“过得有滋有味”。口语，语气温暖。

meaning.en: Polite and well-mannered, and knowing the limits of proper behaviour.
meaning.zh: 讲礼貌，有分寸，举止有节制。

examples.zh: 他有礼有节地拒绝了对方的要求。
examples.en: He turned down their request politely and with restraint.

examples.zh: 作为小主人，要对客人有礼有节。
examples.en: As a young host you should treat guests with courtesy and good manners.

examples.zh: 双方在谈判中有礼有节，没有争吵。
examples.en: The two sides negotiated politely and calmly, without any quarrel.

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate. Formal and positive. Not the same as 有理有节 (reasonable and restrained), the more common diplomatic phrase, though the pronunciation is identical.
usage.zh: 多作状语、谓语，正式而褒义。与读音相同的“有理有节”（有道理、有节制）不同。

natural: with nothing tying you down or worrying you

meaning.en: Free of family burdens or worries, with no one and nothing to hold one back.
meaning.zh: 没有牵累，没有挂念，无忧无虑。

examples.zh: 他孤身一人，无牵无挂，说走就走。
examples.en: He is alone, with no ties, and can go the moment he likes.

examples.zh: 考试结束了，大家无牵无挂地玩了起来。
examples.en: The exams were over, and everyone played without a care.

examples.zh: 她退休后无牵无挂，到处旅行。
examples.en: After retirement she had no burdens and travelled everywhere.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial. Neutral-to-positive; but it can also be a little sad when describing someone alone in the world. Compare 无忧无虑, which is carefree but is not about ties.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，偏褒义，形容孤身一人时也带感伤。与“无忧无虑”相比，更强调没有牵累。

meaning.en: To have no quarrel or grudge between two people.
meaning.zh: 彼此之间没有仇恨，没有矛盾。

examples.zh: 我和你无冤无仇，为什么要害我？
examples.en: I have no quarrel with you, so why do you want to hurt me?

examples.zh: 我们无冤无仇，没必要吵架。
examples.en: We have no feud and no need to argue.

examples.zh: 他们素不相识，无冤无仇，案子很奇怪。
examples.en: They did not know each other and had no feud, so the case is strange.

usage.en: Usually used in rhetorical questions, especially 无冤无仇，为什么……. Neutral; a plea that the other person has no reason to attack. The opposite is 有仇有怨 or 不共戴天.
usage.zh: 常用于反问，如“无冤无仇，为什么……”。反义为“不共戴天”。

meaning.en: Selfless and unafraid, ready to act for others without thought of oneself.

examples.zh: 医生们无私无畏，冲在抗疫最前线。
examples.en: The doctors were selfless and fearless and went to the front line of the epidemic.

examples.zh: 消防员无私无畏的精神值得我们学习。
examples.en: We should learn from the firefighters' selfless, fearless spirit.

examples.zh: 他们无私无畏地救起了落水儿童。
examples.en: They fearlessly rescued the child who had fallen into the water.

usage.en: Predicate, attributive or adverbial. Strongly positive and formal; used in praise of heroes and public servants. Often used with 大公无私 or 英勇无畏.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语、状语，褒义，用于赞扬英雄和公职人员。

meaning.en: Going on and on with no end in sight.
meaning.zh: 没完没了，不停地继续下去。

examples.zh: 无休无止的雨让大家心烦。
examples.en: The endless rain annoyed everyone.

examples.zh: 他们为小事无休无止地争吵。
examples.en: They argue endlessly about trivial things.

examples.zh: 无休无止的加班让员工们疲惫不堪。
examples.en: Endless overtime left the staff exhausted.

usage.en: Predicate, attributive or adverbial. Often negative in tone, expressing annoyance at something that will not stop. It works with 争吵, 加班, 纠缠 and 下雨.
usage.zh: 多作定语、状语，常含厌烦，常与“争吵”“加班”“纠缠”搭配。

natural: with nothing to cover or block

meaning.en: Open and unobstructed, with nothing to block the view; also, speaking without holding back.
meaning.zh: 没有遮挡，没有拦阻；也指说话毫无顾忌。

examples.zh: 草原上无遮无拦，风吹得很大。
examples.en: The grassland is wide open and the wind blows hard.

examples.zh: 站在山顶，视野无遮无拦。
examples.en: From the top of the mountain the view is unobstructed.

examples.zh: 他说话无遮无拦，常常得罪人。
examples.en: He speaks without holding back and often offends people.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. The first sense is descriptive and neutral; the second (an outspoken person) is slightly critical. In the second sense it is close to 口无遮拦.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。第一义为中性描写，第二义指说话不顾忌，略含批评，近于“口无遮拦”。

meaning.en: Silent and leaving no trace; also, unknown and without any reputation.
meaning.zh: 没有声音，也没有气味，指不为人知，没有名声。

examples.zh: 他一生无声无臭，没有留下什么名声。
examples.en: He lived a life of obscurity and left no name behind.

examples.zh: 这件事做得无声无臭，没人发现。
examples.en: The matter was done so quietly that no one noticed.

examples.zh: 这位作家去世后，作品也渐渐无声无臭了。
examples.en: After the writer's death his works too faded into obscurity.

story.en: The ode in praise of King Wen says: 'The workings of High Heaven have no sound and no smell' (上天之载，无声无臭).
story.zh: 《诗经·大雅·文王》：“上天之载，无声无臭。”

date.zh: 西周初至春秋中叶 · 前11—前6世纪
date.en: early Western Zhou to mid Spring and Autumn, 11th–6th c. BC

usage.en: Predicate or complement; literary. It can mean doing something very quietly, or being unknown. The Book of Songs line describes Heaven's workings as without sound or smell. Today the word is mostly about obscurity.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语，书面语。可指悄悄地，也指默默无闻。出自《诗经》，原指天道无声无味。

meaning.en: Not steady: now good, now bad.
meaning.zh: 一会儿好，一会儿坏，不稳定。

examples.zh: 这几天天气时好时坏。
examples.en: The weather has been changeable these days.

examples.zh: 我的成绩时好时坏，要更努力才行。
examples.en: My grades go up and down, so I must work harder.

examples.zh: 手机信号时好时坏，打不通电话。
examples.en: The phone signal comes and goes, so I can't get through.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial. Used for weather, health, mood, grades and signals. The pattern 时A时B (时好时坏, 时快时慢) is productive.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，可说天气、健康、情绪、成绩。“时A时B”格式能产性强。

literal: as if · bright · as if · dark
natural: as if bright, as if dark

meaning.en: Dim and unclear, hard to make out.
meaning.zh: 光线忽明忽暗，不清楚，难以分辨。

examples.zh: 远处的灯光若明若暗。
examples.en: The lights in the distance are faint and flickering.

examples.zh: 他的态度若明若暗，让人捉摸不透。
examples.en: His attitude is unclear and hard to read.

examples.zh: 山路上月光若明若暗。
examples.en: The moonlight on the mountain path is dim and changing.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Describes light, shadow or an unclear attitude. Close to 若隐若现 but concerns brightness rather than appearing and vanishing.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，形容光线、影子或不明朗的态度。与“若隐若现”相近，但更侧重明暗。

natural: seeming to smile but not smiling

meaning.en: A faint smile that may hide scorn, teasing or mixed feelings.
meaning.zh: 好像在笑又不是真笑，表情难以捉摸。

equivalents: a smile that is not quite a smile

examples.zh: 他似笑非笑地看着我。
examples.en: He looked at me with a half smile.

examples.zh: 妈妈似笑非笑，我不知道她有没有生气。
examples.en: Mum had a faint smile and I could not tell whether she was angry.

examples.zh: 画中人物似笑非笑，很神秘。
examples.en: The figure in the painting has a faint, mysterious smile.

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate. Used of a facial expression, usually hinting at mockery or hidden thoughts. Literary style, though it is common in stories. Note 似 is read sì here.
usage.zh: 多作状语、谓语，指带有嘲讽或心思的表情。多见于小说。“似”读sì。

meaning.en: To wander around with no purpose, often idling away time.
meaning.zh: 到处闲逛，没有目的，多指不做正事。

examples.zh: 放学后别东游西逛，早点回家。
examples.en: Don't loiter after school and go straight home.

examples.zh: 他整天东游西逛，不好好工作。
examples.en: He wanders about all day without doing proper work.

examples.zh: 假期里我们在小镇上东游西逛，悠闲自在。
examples.en: In the holiday we strolled about the little town, relaxed and carefree.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial. Slightly critical when used of someone who should be working or studying, neutral for relaxed sightseeing. Pattern 东A西B.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，指不务正业时略带批评，指悠闲游玩时为中性。

meaning.zh: 东边和西边的邻居，泛指邻居。

examples.zh: 过年了，我们给东邻西舍送去了糖果。
examples.en: At the New Year we gave sweets to the neighbours.

examples.zh: 东邻西舍都来帮忙盖房子。
examples.en: The neighbours all came to help build the house.

examples.zh: 他和东邻西舍的关系很好。
examples.en: He gets on well with all the neighbours.

usage.en: A noun phrase used as a subject or object. Warm and old-fashioned; typical of village life. Similar to 左邻右舍, which is more common.
usage.zh: 名词性，用作主语、宾语，亲切，带乡土气息。与更常用的“左邻右舍”相近。

meaning.en: To deceive everyone in a shameless way, as if heaven and earth could be fooled.
meaning.zh: 欺骗天地，形容胆大妄为，毫无顾忌地欺骗人。

equivalents: to lie to heaven and earth

examples.zh: 这种欺天罔地的骗局，迟早会被揭穿。
examples.en: This shameless fraud will sooner or later be exposed.

examples.zh: 他欺天罔地，把公款占为己有。
examples.en: He shamelessly pocketed public money.

examples.zh: 做人不能欺天罔地，要讲良心。
examples.en: One must not deceive heaven and earth; one needs a conscience.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; strongly critical and literary. Used for serious fraud or shameless lies, rarely for small fibs.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，批评较重，书面语，多指严重欺骗，不用于小谎。
